Priya Sharma: Legal note: their case study references a customer by name. Do we have signed release? If not, request redaction or permission.

Maya Ortiz: I'll ask their PM now for written permission and a short bio for the quoted customer.

design-bot: Auto-check results:
- 300x75 PNG: missing
- square PNG 400x400: present
- mono SVG: present
- brand guidelines: present

Liam Rees: If 300x75 is missing we can crop the wide svg and export. Will do if partner doesn't provide. Also their lockup has <8px min size — recommend 10px.

Priya Sharma: Partner legal responded: they have permission but we need to avoid using customer's logo. OK to use name and anonymized logo descriptor.

Maya Ortiz: OK noted. Action items:
- Liam: export 300x75 and adjusted lockup (EOD)
- Priya: draft the co-marketing permission clause to include in the portal (today)
- Maya: confirm publish date with Synaptic (target next Wednesday)

Liam Rees: Uploaded `synaptic_logo_300x75.png` and `synaptic_lockup_adj.svg` to drive: drive.redwood.co/synaptic/assets

Maya Ortiz: Partner confirms launch Wednesday 2029-06-12. Legal approved copy and requested a short quote from their PM.

Priya Sharma: I'll insert the permission clause into the partner portal and send the final go/no-go email once quote is in.
